title: SemanticEngineConfig
description: کلیدهای پیکربندی Semantic Engine. همان نام‌کلیدهای contributes.configuration در package.json، تا یک تنظیم در VS Code و در اجرای مستقل دقیقاً یک معنی داشته باشد. src/host/configSchemaSync.test.ts این آینه بودن را نگه می‌دارد.

semanticEngine.dataDir.description: Directory holding generated data (indexes, blueprints, locks, logs) instead of the workspace root. Defaults to the platform data directory: $XDG_DATA_HOME/semantic-engine on Linux, ~/Library/Application Support/SemanticEngine on macOS, %LOCALAPPDATA%/SemanticEngine on Windows. Also settable with SEMANTIC_ENGINE_DATA_DIR.

semanticEngine.artifactLocation.description: Where artifacts are written: 'external' (default) writes under semanticEngine.dataDir, 'in-root' keeps the legacy <workspace>/.semantic-engine for backward compatibility. An explicit --out always wins.

semanticEngine.treeSitter.grammarDir.description: Directory containing tree-sitter WASM grammar files. Defaults to 'tree-sitter-grammars' in the workspace root.

semanticEngine.embedding.enabled.description: Generate real vector embeddings for chunks using a local ONNX model.

semanticEngine.embedding.cacheDir.description: Directory to cache the local embedding model. Defaults to Hugging Face cache directory.

semanticEngine.vectorSearch.backend.description: Vector search backend: auto switches to usearch for large datasets.

semanticEngine.vectorSearch.usearchThres.description: Minimum number of vector chunks to use usearch backend in auto mode.

semanticEngine.llm.enabled.description: Use a real LLM for AI metadata generation (requires API key).

semanticEngine.llm.baseUrl.description: Custom base URL for OpenAI-compatible API (e.g., http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama).

semanticEngine.llm.apiKeyEnvVar.description: Name of the environment variable holding the LLM API key. The key itself is never stored in settings, which are synced in plain text.

semanticEngine.lsp.enabled.description: Use a language server for symbol extraction and diagnostics. Off by default: on this repository the language server costs 7.7s and 809MB where tree-sitter costs 213ms and 65MB.

semanticEngine.lsp.requestTimeoutMs.description: How long a single language server request may take before it is cancelled.

semanticEngine.lsp.idleTimeoutMs.description: Shut a language server down after this long without use. 0 keeps it alive for the whole session.

semanticEngine.lsp.warmupTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for a server that indexes on startup (gopls, rust-analyzer) before continuing without it.

semanticEngine.lsp.maxServerMemoryMB.description: Restart a language server whose resident memory passes this. 0 disables the limit.

semanticEngine.lsp.servers.description: Per-server overrides keyed by server id, for example {"pyright": {"command": "/opt/pyright-langserver"}} or {"gopls": {"disabled": true}}. Nothing is ever installed automatically.
